about.title: About URBN Dental Implants & Invisalign | Uptown
text: Welcome to URBN Dental, a modern Houston dental office providing high-quality dentistry to patients of all ages. We’re dedicated to helping our patients get exactly the care they need for their smiles. If you’re new to our practice, we’re honored that you’ve decided to trust your smile to us. We always attempt to exceed our patient’s expectations, so please let us know what we can do to improve your experience.

After several years of professional Dental University education, Cosmetic Dentists Dr. David Nguyen and Dr. Benjamin Golik wanted to further their passions with a focus on Aesthetic Dental Arts. Only a select few ranking graduate dentists are selected to train in these highly selective postgraduate residencies. Both dentists met at the Level 1 Lutheran Medical Center Trauma Center Dental Clinic, which New York University now owns.

Throughout their Dental Residency, they honed their skills and techniques using state-of-the-art equipment and tools. They established themselves as leaders and excelled in smile transformation and oral health stabilization. They also provided their communities with outstanding service to their patients, motivating them to give back and create something new in the dental field.
